post.description: Queue a message for the GSM worker. The caller owns it, which makes it outbound.

Queue the same text for many contacts: one message each, to the contact's primary number
(else its first). Contacts that cannot be messaged are skipped and reported, the rest are
queued together in one transaction, in the order given.

Mark a received message read for the caller only. Idempotent, and harmless for a sent
message (which is never unread).

Answer a received message: queue a message to the number it came from, linked to it.

Allowed to whoever can create messages and can see the original, so it needs no contacts
access. The number is the one stored on the original, even if the contact's numbers changed.

Clear the failed sign-ins (and wrong-password guesses) that lock this user out. Harmless
for a user who is not locked.

Hand the next queued message to the worker, leased to it for ``lease_seconds`` (extend or
report before then). Waits up to ``wait_seconds`` for one to arrive.
Health of a device. An error is kept as history after the device recovers.

Store a received SMS, finding or creating the sender's contact. Answers 200 only after the
commit, so the worker may then forget the message on the device.
What happened to a message the worker holds. ``sent`` means the device accepted it.
The handshake and heartbeat: records what the worker is, and tells it which device it serves.
